description.en: Rule library ID. If left blank, the default is Default.

description.zh:
用户通过 SubmitAuditNote 接口得到的 taskId。这是自定义规则库任务索引的唯一标识，在使用时务必妥善保存。
在您使用本接口时，如果在入参中包含 taskId，能获取到您已通过 SubmitAuditNote 接口上传成功，但未通过 ConfirmAndProcessAuditNote 进行后处理的结构化规则库；而入参中不包含 taskId 时，则能获取到已进行后处理，可以用于审核的结构化规则库。
description.en: The task ID obtained by calling the SubmitAuditNote API. This is the unique identifier for the custom rule library task index. Store it securely when using it. When using this API, if the input parameters include \`taskId\`, you can retrieve the structured rule library that you successfully uploaded via the SubmitAuditNote API but has not undergone post-processing by ConfirmAndProcessAuditNote. If the input parameters do not include \`taskId\`, you can retrieve the structured rule library that has undergone post-processing and is available for auditing.

description.zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取[业务空间ID（Workspace ID）](~~2782167~~)
description.en: The unique identifier of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace. Get the [Workspace ID](~~2782167~~).
